title: First meeting with a Faisalabad textile mill owner, Urdu mixed with English

brief.title: Inventory system for Rasheed Textile Mills
brief.goals: Understand the stock problem; propose phase 1; agree a next visit

documents.title: My profile
documents.text: Kamran Javed: 8 years building inventory and ERP systems for textile units in Faisalabad and Sialkot. Past work: Noor Weaving (stock app, 2023), Al-Fazal Processing (barcode dispatch, 2024). Phase 1 scope: yarn store, greige stock, dispatch notes, Urdu and English reports. Timeline: 3 months.

events.text: Walaikum assalam beta. Pehle yeh batao, textile mein pehle kaam kiya hai?
events.reference:
Ji, 8 saal se textile units ke liye.
- **Noor Weaving**: stock app, 2023
- **Al-Fazal Processing**: barcode dispatch, 2024
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke aap ne textile mein kaam kiya hai.

bad.answer: Ji, hum ne 50 mills ke liye system banaye hain.

events.text: Ji, aath saal se. Noor Weaving aur Al-Fazal ke liye kaam kiya hai.
Achha. Hamara budget 15 lakh tak hai, is se upar nahi.

facts: Them: budget up to 15 lakh PKR, not more (minute 2)

events.text: Ji, pehla phase 12 lakh mein ho jayega.
Hamare paas teen godam hain, ek mill ke andar, do bahar.
Stock ka hisaab Urdu mein bhi milega?
events.reference:
Ji, reports Urdu aur English dono mein.
- **Phase 1**: yarn store, greige stock, dispatch notes
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke stock ki report Urdu mein milegi ya nahi.

events.text: Mera beta bhi aa gaya hai, woh bhi sun raha hai.

bad.answer: Assalam o alaikum, aap ka bohat shukriya.

events.text: Yeh kaam kitne waqt mein ho jayega?
events.reference:
Pehla phase 3 months mein.
- **Start**: yarn store se
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke kaam kitne waqt mein hoga.

events.text: Beta ek baar phir batao, kitna waqt lagega?
events.reference:
3 months, pehla phase.
Roman Urdu: Woh dobara waqt pooch rahe hain.

events.text: To yeh kaam pandrah lakh mein ho jayega na?
events.reference:
Ji, pehla phase 12 lakh mein, 15 lakh se kam.
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke kaam pandrah lakh mein hoga ya nahi.

events.text: Aur kuch poochna hai aap ne?
events.reference:
Ji, ek baat.
- **Visit**: agle hafte mill aa kar stock dekh sakta hoon?
Roman Urdu: Woh pooch rahe hain ke aap ka koi sawal hai.
